studio.name: Studio HQ
studio.venture: UK commercial construction — niche not yet chosen
studio.statusLine: Network access verified working, including GB App Store search. Phase 1 can begin. Waiting on three Gate 1 inputs from the founder.
studio.killCriterion: The kill date is set in Phase 1, before any research returns, and written into validation/OFFER.md.

needsYou.title: Name the construction roles and firms you can actually reach
needsYou.why: The rubric scores how close your contacts are to the buyer. Reachability was the weakest dimension in all four of the previous venture’s finalists, so this is the input most likely to change which niche wins.

needsYou.title: Set the 8-week validation budget
needsYou.why: Cash for organic validation before any app is built. Shapes the Phase 2 experiment plan. The previous venture’s plans came in at £170–£570.

needsYou.title: State your risk appetite on market size
needsYou.why: How much eventual business size weighs against the odds it works at all. Tunes one scoring weight and the kill thresholds.

phases.name: Research
phases.detail: 25+ niches, weights locked before evidence, counter-incentive and mechanic gates run INSIDE this phase, then adversarial deep dives on the survivors.

phases.name: Validation kit
phases.detail: Freeze the offer and engine contracts first, then rules engine with golden vectors, landing page delivering the aha free in-browser, and the 8-week plan with pre-committed thresholds.

phases.name: iOS MVP
phases.detail: SwiftUI, SwiftData, StoreKit 2, engine ported to a local Swift package passing the same vectors, then an adversarial review pass.

phases.name: Ship-readiness
phases.detail: Green CI on macOS, App Store listing, final report.

gates.name: Pick the niche
gates.question: Which surviving niche do we build?
gates.alsoNeedFromYou: Which roles and companies you can reach, your validation budget, and your risk appetite on market size.

gates.name: Go or no-go after validation
gates.question: Did the validation kit hit its pre-committed thresholds by the kill date?

funnel.note: Targets are pre-committed in Phase 2, before any traffic arrives, so they cannot be moved afterwards to fit the result.

risks.risk: The card schemes, accreditation bodies, inspection companies and insurers all sell renewals, so they probably already email every date. That pattern killed three of four finalists on the previous venture.
risks.mitigation: The counter-incentive test is hard gate 2 and carries 20% of the score. Verify who notifies before investing research in any candidate.

risks.risk: British Standards are paywalled by BSI, and many trade-body documents are too. A niche whose intervals exist only inside a paid standard cannot ship.
risks.mitigation: Hard gate 4. Verify the free-source carve-out explicitly for every interval, rather than assuming it.

risks.risk: Most obvious construction ideas are about chasing other people for their documents, which needs a backend and accounts.
risks.mitigation: Hard gate 5, applied early and strictly. The target is one person's phone, offline in a site cabin.

risks.risk: RESOLVED 24 Oct. The allowlist was widened and verified: hse.gov.uk and legislation.gov.uk return real content on deep pages, and GB App Store search returns app names, sellers, prices and rating counts. Primary sources and the mechanic gate are both available for the first time.
risks.mitigation: Residual risk only: one App Store search returned an empty body before a retry succeeded, so a single empty result is treated as transient and retried, never scored as "no competitor found".

risks.risk: No Swift compiler in this environment. The first real compile happens in GitHub Actions on macOS.
risks.mitigation: Conservative stable-API Swift, an adversarial line-by-line review, and CI watched until green.

log.what: Studio scaffolding seeded from the previous venture: ten agent charters, the standing rules, the rubric with the counter-incentive gate, the frozen-contract templates and this dashboard.

Step 0 network verification: all three test hosts refused. www.hse.gov.uk, www.legislation.gov.uk and itunes.apple.com each failed DNS resolution; the proxy recorded a 403 on CONNECT for all three. Control hosts github.com and registry.npmjs.org returned normally, so the egress path works and the allowed-domains list is the sole cause. Web search returns snippets only. Stopped and waiting for the founder; no research scouts dispatched.

Founder widened the network allowlist. Re-verified: www.hse.gov.uk 200, www.legislation.gov.uk 200, itunes.apple.com lookup 200 with parsed JSON. Deep pages confirmed (HSE thorough-examinations guidance; LOLER 1998 reg 9 on legislation.gov.uk). GB App Store search returns names, sellers, prices and rating counts, so the mechanic gate is runnable. One transient empty search body observed and retried successfully. Step 0 closed.
